src.title: Macro-Friendly Peruvian Chicken with Aji Verde

recipes.title: Macro-Friendly Peruvian-Style Chicken with Aji Verde
steps: Mix the chicken thighs with the tomato paste, aji amarillo, honey and spices until fully coated. Marinate at least 30 minutes, or a few hours.
Cook the chicken in a hot pan, grill or air fryer until charred at the edges and cooked through (165°F / 74°C).
Blend the Greek yogurt, cottage cheese, aji amarillo, cilantro, green onions, garlic, jalapeño, lime juice, salt and pepper until smooth and bright green.
Serve the chicken with the aji verde for dipping (roasted potatoes on the side are optional).
recipes.notes: Ingredients and macros are the creator's (per serving of chicken and sauce, potatoes not included). Peruvian commenters note authentic pollo a la brasa uses aji panca in the marinade, so add a teaspoon for a smokier, more traditional flavor.
